paheli.question: I spin round and round and give cool air to everyone. I am most useful during the summer. Tell me, who am I?

dialogue: Teacher: Raju, what would you do if a lion suddenly appeared in front of you?
Raju: Sir, I would immediately climb up a tree.
Teacher: And what if the lion climbs the tree too?
Raju: Sir, then I would jump into the river.
Teacher: And what if the lion jumps into the river too?
Raju: Sir, whose side are you on—mine or the lion's?!

prerak_kahani.title: Continuous Effort
prerak_kahani.story: A tiny ant was trying to climb a wall while carrying a grain larger than its own size. It fell repeatedly, but it did not lose courage and kept trying continuously. Finally, through its dedication and hard work, it reached the top of the wall. A young boy watching this learned that we should never stop out of fear of difficulties, but should keep trying again and again.
prerak_kahani.moral: With continuous effort, even the most difficult goals can be achieved.

word_of_the_day.meaning: Continued effort to achieve something despite difficulties, failure, or opposition.
word_of_the_day.example: Hard work and perseverance are essential to succeed in exams.

today_in_history.fact: On September 6, 1965, during the Indo-Pakistani War, the Indian Armed Forces demonstrated invincible courage on the western border, making a historic contribution to defending the nation.

did_you_know.fact: Did you know that butterflies taste their food with their feet, not their mouths?

quote_of_the_day.quote: Arise, awake, and stop not till the goal is reached.
quote_of_the_day.author: Swami Vivekananda
